Local match commentary credits

Fresh analysis uses KittenTTS Nano0.8int8 with Hugo, a male voice. This local model has no instruction-based emotion control. Recorded Tom reactions continue to handle shots, saves and goals.

Model and frontend

KittenML model and voice embeddings and KittenTTS Web frontend are Apache-2.0. License.

The CE phonemizer engine is an original Apache-2.0 implementation. Its English pronunciation data comes from eSpeak NG, under GPLv3. Unmodified plain-text source files are bundled as en_rules and en_list. GPL license. Exact frontend source, data and build/extraction scripts: source archive.

Speech runs on your device using ONNX Runtime Web1.24.3 (Microsoft, MIT license). No text or audio is sent to a synthesis service.
